en.topic_title: Japanese, Chinese coast guards face off near disputed islands

zh.topic_title: Japanese, Chinese coast guards face off near disputed islands

en.topic_title: Japanese, Chinese coast guards face off near disputed islands
en.topic_summary:
Ships from Japan’s and China’s coast guards faced off near disputed islands Tuesday, with each claiming they drove out the other’s vessels that had intruded into their territorial waters.



An undated photo shows a Japan Coast Guard vesel, and a China Coast Guard ship. File photo: Japan Coast Guard.



The incident occurred near uninhabited islands claimed as the Senkaku in Japan and the Diaoyu in China, which sit between Taiwan and Okinawa and have caused diplomatic tensions
